D022-D013_h001.question:

A whole pizza, or half a box of cookies, just gone in a short time. It’s not that I’m hungry; it’s like I can’t stop.

Afterward, I feel so guilty, so overwhelmed, that sometimes I make myself throw up. Not every time, and not regularly, I don’t think. But it happens. I’ve started tying my self-worth to my weight—like if I’m lighter, I’m better, more in control, more deserving. That’s not healthy, I know. I’ve also felt down, tired, unmotivated.
